name: Careful Spell
description: Allies you choose (up to your Charisma modifier) automatically succeed on saves against your area spell and take no damage from it.

name: Distant Spell
description: Double a spell's range, or give a touch spell a 30 ft range.

name: Empowered Spell
description: Reroll up to your Charisma modifier in low damage dice. Combines with other Metamagic.

name: Heightened Spell
description: One target of the spell has disadvantage on its saves against it.

name: Quickened Spell
description: Cast a spell that takes an Action as a Bonus Action instead.

name: Seeking Spell
description: If you miss with a spell attack, reroll the d20. Combines with other Metamagic.

name: Twinned Spell
description: A spell that gains targets from higher slots (like Hold Person) gets one more target.
